//: Asset manifest (D18). Flapforge is procedural-first: this list is EMPTY on purpose and every renderer falls back to ProceduralArt. An entry overrides the procedural art of one id and has the shape {"id": "<unique id, e.g. bird/classic or worlds/green_fields/pipe>", "path": "<path under /assets/, e.g. sprites/birds/classic.png; a leading assets/ or / is accepted too, so plan section 4's assets/fonts/... form resolves>", "kind": "SPRITE | SHEET | AUDIO | FONT", "license": "<SPDX id or licence name>", "source": "<where it came from>"}. A SHEET entry may add "frameWidth", "frameHeight" and "frames". AssetManager resolves ids only through this file; it never scans directories.
